requirement: Track the institutional hierarchy and student program
acceptance: Program, unit and pinned curriculum resolve unambiguously.

requirement: Pin curriculum and classification to a student program
acceptance: A remains selected unless an authorized migration occurs.

requirement: Evaluate restricted policy expressions with reasons
acceptance: Return unmet or review according to explicit provisional rule. Count one recognized completion under the pinned policy.

requirement: Apply term and appointment boundaries
acceptance: Only the first decision may commit. Return window error with no enrolled rows.

requirement: Check instructor, room and bundle compatibility
acceptance: Reject candidate with component, constraint and conflict evidence. Both consume the same physical budget.

requirement: Enroll a complete multi-component bundle
acceptance: One active enrollment and one capacity conflict. At most one commits and the other sees the new total. No enrollment or seat claim survives.

requirement: Drop and swap using the final course set
acceptance: Old enrollment and claims remain active. Reject final set and preserve both.

requirement: Order waitlist offers and protect reserved capacity
acceptance: General access begins at release and total never increases. Eligible head has first opportunity and no duplicate hold.

requirement: Approve scoped exceptions and handle grade correction
acceptance: One review case; student stays enrolled pending decision. Reject self-approval by actor identity.

requirement: Persist a solver run and its inputs
acceptance: No publishable placement; a time limit alone yields no proof. Only current lease generation can complete the run.

requirement: Validate and approve timetable versions
acceptance: Current version stays published and stale error returned. Reject candidate with component, constraint and conflict evidence.

requirement: Suggest compatible student schedules and audit progress
acceptance: No enrollment or seat claim survives. Consume the completion once and explain outstanding group. Count one recognized completion under the pinned policy.

requirement: Allocate by approved priorities and tie breaks
acceptance: Same tie outcome and published cohort metrics.

requirement: Expose scoped reports at a consistent watermark
acceptance: Totals and details share one watermark and permitted scope. Deny the file and audit the attempt.

requirement: Recover registration intent after disconnect
acceptance: Both resolve to one stored outcome and one mutation. Return the stored outcome with no second write.

requirement: Route events and downstream effects durably
acceptance: Consumer deduplicates; ambiguous delivery enters reconciliation. Database fact and outbox survive; catch-up preserves per-key order. One downstream effect per consumer and event ID.

requirement: Import and reconcile prior academic history
acceptance: Quarantine collision and withhold cutover.

requirement: Separate staff access and technical authority
acceptance: No record data returned and access denial recorded. Reject self-approval by actor identity. Deny the file and audit the attempt.

requirement: Require explicit term registration finalization
acceptance: A valid first bundle can be committed below the minimum in draft. Finalization below the floor returns an explained rejection without changing the draft state. A subsequent drop from a finalized plan must maintain the floor or have a valid grant.

requirement: Expand local-time recurrence and exceptions
acceptance: Only approved local occurrences exist with explicit offsets.

requirement: Support keyboard and Persian mixed-direction access
acceptance: Every meeting, status and action is announced in logical order. No personal cache leak or premature success.

requirement: Meet ratified peak workload budgets
acceptance: Record percentiles, errors and saturation against ratified budgets.

requirement: Recover authority from isolated restoration
acceptance: Rebuild projections and quarantine ambiguous sends.

requirement: Maintain scoped access after session changes
acceptance: No record data returned and access denial recorded. No personal cache leak or premature success.

requirement: Qualify release evidence and privacy boundaries
acceptance: No authorization to release until affected acceptance cases have passed. Deny the file and audit the attempt.

requirement: Reconcile stale external financial holds
acceptance: Show pending verification when policy requires a fresh hold; no implicit adverse decision.
